MADHU P SAP EWM Consultant

madhup8722@gmail.com +91 8660820850

PROFESSIONAL OBJECTIVE

Experienced SAP EWM Functional Consultant specialized in warehouse management and system integration. Looking to

leverage my expertise in SAP to optimize supply chain processes and drive continuous improvement for business success.

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY



3+ years of experience in SAP EWM S/4Hana as a functional and configuration consultant.



10+years of experience as a Technical Education Consultant.

Worked on 1 Implementation, 1 Rollout & 2 Support Projects

Have a good understanding of SAP configuration and business processes in Supply Chain Management and Logistics.

Working Knowledge on SAP MM Module.

Good Knowledge of Master Data Management (MDM).

SAP EXPERTISE

Good knowledge of SAP EWM components and business process configuration.

Good understanding of business processes related to warehouse processes and other inventory management.

Experience in preparation of Functional Specification Document (FSD).

Key areas of expertise in Goods Receipt, Deconsolidation, Physical Inventory, Replenishment, Wave Processing,

Picking/Packing.

Configuration EWM warehouse structure, creation of bins, storage types, storage sections, Storage type search sequence

and warehouse process types.

EWM triggered opportunistic Cross docking for outbound driven process.

Strong understanding of the overall business process in the supply chain, knowledge of the solutions that support these

processes.

Worked on Inbound and Outbound POSC



Involved in cutover activities

Working Knowledge in MM – Automatic Account Determination, Release Strategy, Pricing Procedure, Split Valuation,

Physical Inventory, Special Procurement process, Smart Forms.



Involved in preparing user documents and End user training.

Excellent interpersonal personal to facilitate business/technical discussions, document solutions and work well with

people at all levels of the organization.

JOB RELATED SKILLS

Skills Operating tools

: SAP EWM, SAP MM : MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, VLOOKUP

WORK EXPERIENCE

Company: Teamware Solutions

May2025 to till date

Project 3: Maintenance

Client: TCS

Position Title: Sr.SAP EWM Consultant

Taking care of issues pertaining to EWM areas and providing suitable solutions for the same.

Handling issues pertaining to Warehouse Order Creation rule, Wave Management and Physical inventory.

Managing Resource and Queue management and its configuration.

Queue monitoring, error message review, root cause investigation, coordinated action, and reprocessing

Configuration of Storage type search strategies for Put away and picking based on the Business design for receiving and

delivery process.



Involved UAT.

Supporting the physical inventory process.

Handling incidents within SLA period

Providing user trainings regularly along with handouts

Project 2: Rollout SAP EWM

May2022 to March 2025

Client: Jindal Aluminium Limited

Position Title: SAP EWM & MM Functional Consultant

 Contacting the business users for requirements gathering to map into SAP environment..  Define EWM warehouse structure and creation of bin structure.  Define storage types and sections.  Configuration of storage type search sequence.  Configuration of warehouse process types.  Configuration of put-away (Deconsolidation) and stock removal process through POSC.  Configuration of packing specification.  Configured Cross docking Process  Configured Replenishment Cycle  Configuration of Plant, Purchase Organization, Storage Location.  Customization of the master records such as Material Master, Vendor Master, Source list  Configuration of STO Process and configuration availability check procedure.  Involved in cutover activities in maintaining material master and vendor master.  Involved in initial stock upload of physical inventory.  Involved in Unit Testing (UT)  Completely involved in SIT & UAT  Configuration of Release strategy, Release codes for Purchase Requisitions and Purchase Orders.  Responsible for smart form changes related to Request for Quotations and Purchase Orders.  Go Live and Hyper care support  Provided end users with comprehensive training and handouts.

Involved in business meetings and part of information gathering team.

Project 1: EWM Implementation

Client: Jindal Aluminium Limited

Position Title: SAP EWM Functional Consultant

 Attended workshops to gather business requirements and mapping the system as per the business requirement.  Contacting the business users for requirements gathering.  Basic system configuration. Defining and mapping the ECC & EWM warehouses.  Define EWM warehouse structure and creation of bin structure.  Define storage types and sections.  Configuration of storage type search sequence.  Configuration of warehouse process types.  Configuration of put-away (Deconsolidation) and stock removal process through POSC.  Configuration of packing specification.  Quantity classification and Cross line put away  Configuration of PPF and LOSC Process   Completely involved in UAT  Cutover activities  Go live and Hyper care support Involved in UT and SIT Testing

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

3+ years of experience in SAP EWM S/4Hana as a functional and configuration consultant.

10+years of experience as a Technical Education Consultant.
Worked on 1 Implementation, 1 Rollout & 2 Support Projects
Have a good understanding of SAP configuration and business processes in Supply Chain Management and Logistics.
Working Knowledge on SAP MM Module.
Good Knowledge of Master Data Management (MDM).
SAP EXPERTISE
Good knowledge of SAP EWM components and business process configuration.
Good understanding of business processes related to warehouse processes and other inventory management.
Experience in preparation of Functional Specification Document (FSD).
Key areas of expertise in Goods Receipt, Deconsolidation, Physical Inventory, Replenishment, Wave Processing,
Picking/Packing.
Configuration EWM warehouse structure, creation of bins, storage types, storage sections, Storage type search sequence
and warehouse process types.
EWM triggered opportunistic Cross docking for outbound driven process.
Strong understanding of the overall business process in the supply chain, knowledge of the solutions that support these
processes.
Worked on Inbound and Outbound POSC

Involved in cutover activities
Working Knowledge in MM – Automatic Account Determination, Release Strategy, Pricing Procedure, Split Valuation,
Physical Inventory, Special Procurement process, Smart Forms.

Involved in preparing user documents and End user training.
Excellent interpersonal personal to facilitate business/technical discussions, document solutions and work well with
people at all levels of the organization.
JOB RELATED SKILLS
